titles.english: Girls und Panzer das Finale - Part 3
titles.native: ガールズ＆パンツァー 最終章 第3話

description:
The third film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou film series.

Firepower and strategy are the name of the game as the schools square off on three additional battlegrounds. Six teams enter and only the survivors will advance!

(Source: HIDIVE)
